testsOutsideGate.reason: Black-box: drives the built Next app over HTTP against its own database (ci.yml test:feature), so it cannot count towards coverage of the source.
Runs against a deployed staging URL (ci.yml, after the deploy).
Playwright: a browser against a running stack (ci.yml test:e2e).
The reader end to end: starts its own MySQL, Postgres and sportbet image containers, and for parity needs sportbet's image built on the PC.
